name: Freshmarketer
description: Freshmarketer is Freshworks' marketing-automation product for contacts, segmentation, campaigns, journeys, email, web engagement, conversion optimization, and analytics.
agentUseSummary: Enter one exact Freshworks CRM bundle URL and user API key, then let selected agents use identity-free contact operations or approved documented CRM API requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHMARKETER_BUNDLE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Freshmarketer CRM bundle URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the exact HTTPS Freshworks CRM bundle base from API Settings, including its /crm/... bundle alias and excluding /api.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHMARKETER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Freshmarketer API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy your user API key from Freshworks CRM profile API Settings. Its access follows your role and scopes.

capabilities.label: Read contact operations
capabilities.description: List contact views and bounded operational metadata without names, email or phone, addresses, custom fields, accounts, owners, activities, notes, or message content.

capabilities.label: Freshworks CRM API
capabilities.description: Use documented CRM API operations allowed by the connected Freshmarketer user API key.

approvalRequired.label: List contact views
approvalRequired.description: List bounded Freshmarketer contact-view identifiers and names.

approvalRequired.label: List contact metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of contact operational metadata without identity or contact details.

approvalRequired.label: Use Freshworks CRM API
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Freshworks CRM API operation authorized by the connected Freshmarketer user key; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Identity-free contact metadata reads and every broader CRM API operation require approval; bundle binding, secret isolation, provider authorization, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected API-key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; exact bundle binding, secret isolation, bounds, audits, provider authorization, and Freshworks limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted user API key only to the exact normalized Freshworks CRM bundle.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted user API key only to the exact normalized Freshworks CRM bundle.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Freshmarketer CRM bundle URL and user API key are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer enters the exact Freshworks CRM bundle URL and user API key, then Relay verifies filter health, identity-free reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader API behavior, key reset, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Freshworks' official CRM API reference documents exact bundle aliases, user API keys, Token-token authentication, role-scoped access, contact filters and views, CRUD resources, pagination, and response errors.
Freshmarketer documents that each account has an API key in API settings and that resetting the key disconnects integrations.
Freshworks documents shared Freshmarketer/Freshsales Suite contact management and marketing subscription state, supporting the bounded contact-metadata classification.
